content: Life becomes meaningful when it is dedicated to a cause greater than one's petty private interests.
author: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
explanation:
Bridging Eastern metaphysics and Western reason, Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan articulates how spiritual intuition elevates human intellect and fosters universal brotherhood.

This passage emphasizes the vital importance of life and becomes in human life. By moving beyond superficial distractions and grounding attention in timeless ethical principles, we cultivate inner stability, clarity of thought, and genuine resilience.

True realization is never an abstract academic debate—it is an active discipline practiced through conscious daily choices and unwavering integrity.
practicalInsight: Take deliberate ownership of life today: pause before reacting in moments of pressure, and choose the grounded response of integrity and calm.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you compromising your deeper truth regarding life, and how can you align with greater clarity today?
